description: This Java source file defines an interface named Scenario4MultipleSubjects which extends Scenario. It declares constants for scenario group name and multiple subject identifiers, and constructs a complex Policy object with various subject and permission configurations. It also provides default methods to access this policy, scenario group name, and an algorithm application function, serving as a test or configuration fixture within a testing framework.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects
classes.description: An interface extending Scenario, defining a specific policy scenario with multiple subjects and associated permission configurations for testing purposes.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the predefined static Policy object configured with various subjects and permissions.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the scenario group.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Provides a default function that applies a PolicyAlgorithm to determine if permissions on resources are satisfied.
